_about: Hand-maintained part of the CMA data map. Every table in schema cma has one entry under a group; every computed view in cma_read (not a table view, not dq_*) has one entry under derived. flows are the paths the page draws: per source its box (src, a data-id in template.html, null when it has none), its ways in (ways, data-ids) and the groups it fills (doms, group keys); every group is in at least one flow. Columns come from schema.json, never from here. Edit, then run node tools/datamap/build.mjs.

tables.name: crm_record
tables.what: Deals and tickets: pipeline, stage, owner, market, closed; the reason's option value from the mapped dropdown property, never free text (0008zb)
tables.how: HubSpot webhook, read back within seconds; nightly reconcile 02:30

tables.name: crm_record_stage
tables.what: A deal's latest entry into and exit from each pipeline stage that reads its times: pipeline, stage, entered, exited (0008za)
tables.how: HubSpot's own stage history (the calculated hs_v2_date_entered and hs_v2_date_exited properties of each stage that reads times), read with the deal on the webhook's read-back within seconds, else by the next sweep; nightly reconcile 02:30; backfill --again

tables.name: crm_contact
tables.what: Thin contact: country with the slot it came from, language, currency, store, and when it was created in the source (0008u)
tables.how: Read when a deal, ticket, email or inbox thread points to it (the email poll every minute, once, after the email or thread), every country slot and created-time slot (the object's createdAt and the configured properties, the earliest kept); re-read every 10 min in its first hour; nightly reconcile

tables.name: crm_contact_ref
tables.what: A contact's ids in other systems, such as its Shopify id
tables.how: With every contact read

tables.name: crm_call
tables.what: Call engagements logged on the contact
tables.how: HubSpot webhook; nightly reconcile

tables.name: crm_association
tables.what: Links between CRM objects, such as deal to contact
tables.how: With every read-back, and the email poll's engagements (email to contact, deal, ticket)

tables.name: form_submission
tables.what: Form submissions: form, page, UTM, contact id only, and the answers to the form's kept choice fields (option values only)
tables.how: Form poll: every counted form every minute, every polled-only form every forms_poll_interval_minutes (default 5, staggered by form; CMA-069), counted in Intake or not (addition 0008p); the nightly reconcile reads every polled form's submissions of the last 26 hours and writes those the poll missed; the form backfill fills a stored submission's empty answers once

tables.name: crm_task
tables.what: Tasks: owner, status, type, priority, due and completed times, the contact, deal and ticket by id; never body or subject
tables.how: HubSpot webhook (task creation, deletion, status, due, owner, completion, type, priority, associations), read back within seconds; nightly reconcile 02:30; backfill by hand (since 0008n)

tables.name: connection_task_status
tables.what: Task statuses seen per connection, with is_done as configuration
tables.how: Seeded by the first task read of each status ref; is_done and the label set on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: connection_task_type
tables.what: Task types seen per connection, with is_callback and is_counted as configuration
tables.how: Seeded by the first task read of each type ref; is_callback and is_counted set on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: email_message
tables.what: Emails, metadata only: CRM email engagements and inbox messages kept apart; direction, status, time, actor kind, the agent's owner id, category, the mailbox (channel account) a message went through, an engagement's origin code (inbox copies and automations told apart by the connection's settings)
tables.how: Email poll every minute (engagements modified since its cursor, with the origin property the connection names; inbox messages of changed threads, with their mailbox), the nightly reconcile (last 26 hours) and the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: email_thread
tables.what: Inbox conversations: inbox, channel, the mailbox it came in through, open or closed, the current agent, contact and ticket ids, spam
tables.how: Email poll every minute (threads whose latest message is newer than its cursor; the open check every email_open_check_minutes, default 15; CMA-069), the nightly reconcile (last 26 hours) with the trash check, the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: email_thread_event
tables.what: Assignments, closes, reopens and inbox moves of conversations: actor kind and owner ids only
tables.how: Email poll every minute (with the messages of changed threads), the nightly reconcile and the backfill; only when the connection's email_poll is on

tables.name: telephony_call
tables.what: Calls: direction, start, answer, end, talk time, missed reason, line, user
tables.how: Aircall webhook per call event, call read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill by hand

tables.name: telephony_call_tag
tables.what: Tags on each call
tables.how: With the call read

tables.name: telephony_number
tables.what: Lines, their market and whether they count
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; counting set on Configuration

tables.name: telephony_tag
tables.what: The tag catalog, whether a tag counts and what it means (not reached, incorrect data, call type, courtesy attempt, courtesy completed positive, neutral or negative; 0008zc, incorrect data 0008zd)
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; counting and meaning set on Configuration, Sources, ingest never writes the meaning

tables.name: telephony_missed_reason
tables.what: Missed-reason labels, service level and callback switches
tables.how: Seed, then Configuration → Sources

tables.name: call_link
tables.what: Aircall call matched to its HubSpot call
tables.how: Sweep every minute, over the last 2 hours

tables.name: commerce_store
tables.what: One row per Shopify store: market, currency, zone
tables.how: Set per store at rollout

tables.name: commerce_customer
tables.what: Customer: state, order count, spend, matched CRM contact
tables.how: Shopify webhook, read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill per store

tables.name: commerce_order
tables.what: Order: amounts, status, kind (first, repeat, renewal), landing page, UTM
tables.how: Shopify webhook, read back within seconds; nightly check; backfill per store

tables.name: commerce_order_line
tables.what: Order lines: SKU, quantity, price
tables.how: With the order read

tables.name: review_channel
tables.what: A review platform's channels per connection: name and locale from the platform, the market each serves and whether its reviews count (configuration); a channel gone from the platform's list is marked, never deleted (0008ze)
tables.how: Reviews poll hourly (the channel list first, again with the nightly reconcile and the backfill); a new channel lands without a market and not counted; market and counted set on Configuration, Sources, which ingest never overwrites

tables.name: review
tables.what: Reviews, metadata only: channel, type, state, published, rating 1 to 5, submitted and updated times, reply, invite event type, transaction reference, and the link to an order or a CRM contact by id; never the reviewer's name, email or phone, nor a title or text (0008ze); the transaction reference holds an order reference only, never an @ (check review_reference_no_at, 0008zf)
tables.how: Reviews poll hourly (each channel's reviews after its cursor less two hours), nightly reconcile (the last reviews_reconcile_days, default 30), backfill by hand; polling only, the platform sends no webhook; the reviewer's email is used in memory to find the CRM contact, then dropped

tables.name: device
tables.what: The asset register's devices per connection, mirrored read-only: record id, serial, model, market and device status from the catalogs (null when unmapped), warehouse, customer, subscription and order references, shipment, stock, warranty and end-of-life dates, named ids of other systems (such as NetSuite's), the row as mapped (raw, key allow-list, never an @); missing from the latest full snapshot as source_deleted_at; never a name, email, phone or address (0008zi)
tables.how: Airtable API: changed records every 15 minutes, full snapshot nightly (ingest-poll-assets every 5 minutes, each connection on its assets_poll_interval_minutes, default 15; the full snapshot in the nightly reconcile at 03:30), loaded in chunks of assets_load_chunk rows (default 1000) by cma.ingest_load_device_chunk, each chunk its own call and nothing staged, and a full snapshot ends with cma.ingest_mark_devices_missing (0008zk); CSV fallback a person loads in one call with cma.load_device_snapshot

tables.name: device_component
tables.what: A device's components per kind (pads, battery) with serial and recorded expiry; one current row per device and kind, a changed serial an observed replacement (replaced_at) from the first load on (0008zi)
tables.how: Airtable API: changed records every 15 minutes, full snapshot nightly (with its device, in chunks by cma.ingest_load_device_chunk, 0008zk); CSV fallback (with its device, by the same load)

tables.name: device_import_row
tables.what: The device import's staged rows: a batch key and the export's mapped columns as text, written through the view device_import_staging (the COPY target) and deleted by the load; a value holding an @ is kept as a bare @, the audit log keeps a staged row's keys only; no name, email, phone or address column (0008zi)
tables.how: CSV fallback only (0008zk): staged by tools/devices-to-staging.mjs and psql \copy, read, loaded and emptied by cma.load_device_snapshot in one call; the Airtable API read stages nothing, it loads in chunks by cma.ingest_load_device_chunk

tables.name: device_model
tables.what: Device models with name, brand and the labels the register writes for each (aliases) (0008zi)
tables.how: Tenant configuration: seed 02 for Pulse4all Subscriptions, changed in Studio (no configuration screen yet); read by every load of the register, by the API (0008zj) or from its CSV export

tables.name: device_component_kind
tables.what: The kinds of component that come due (pads, battery), with name and sort order; the key device is reserved for a device's end of life (0008zi)
tables.how: Tenant configuration: seed 02 for Pulse4all Subscriptions, changed in Studio (no configuration screen yet); read by every load of the register, by the API (0008zj) or from its CSV export

tables.name: maintenance_rule
tables.what: Per model and component kind: the interval in months from the anchor date (the day a replacement was first seen, else the last shipment, else the first) and the lead days before the due date (0008zi)
tables.how: Tenant configuration: seed 02 for Pulse4all Subscriptions, changed in Studio (no configuration screen yet); read by every load of the register, by the API (0008zj) or from its CSV export

tables.name: device_status
tables.what: Device statuses with the flags in the field, in stock and tracked (forecast), and the labels the register writes for each; reporting reads the flags, never a name (0008zi)
tables.how: Tenant configuration: seed 02 for Pulse4all Subscriptions, changed in Studio (no configuration screen yet); read by every load of the register, by the API (0008zj) or from its CSV export

tables.name: integration_connection
tables.what: One row per account of a source (portal, Aircall account, store, review platform account, asset register base)
tables.how: Configuration → Sources

tables.name: connection_pipeline
tables.what: CRM pipelines, counted or routed; a ticket pipeline's own SLA in business minutes (0008o); a deal pipeline marked as an order pipeline (0008u)
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly; switches (counted, routed, order pipeline) and the SLA on Configuration

tables.name: connection_stage
tables.what: CRM pipeline stages, closed or open; a deal stage's outcome (won, lost or none) and where it came from (0008u); whether its entry and exit times are read (0008za)
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly, the outcome from the stage's probability (1 won, 0 and closed lost) unless a person set it on Configuration, Sources, which the catalog then keeps; read times on for a counted pipeline's stage unless a person switched it on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: connection_call_outcome
tables.what: CRM call outcomes with a connected flag that no figure reads since 0008zc (the outcome decides neither Connected nor Conversation)
tables.how: Catalog at most hourly

tables.name: connection_form
tables.what: CRM forms: polled, counted in Intake, category, market, kept choice fields, market field, lead condition
tables.how: Form catalog hourly; switches on Configuration (Sources; kept fields, market field and lead condition by the runbook)

tables.name: connection_form_field
tables.what: Fields of the CRM's forms: name, kind (dropdown, radio, checkboxes, other) and a choice field's option values
tables.how: With the form catalog, at most hourly; an option a form drops stays as retired

tables.name: form_category
tables.what: Form categories (what a form is for, such as quote or cancellation): code, name, order, active
tables.how: Configuration (Sources); the tenant's own, filled by the runbook

tables.name: connection_field
tables.what: Which source property feeds which CMA field; a contact's country, refs and created time in ordered slots; the property's data type as the adapter last read it, which decides whether a reason is stored (0008zb); on an asset register connection the register's fields: a device's staging columns, a component kind's serial and expiry, the named ids (0008zj)
tables.how: Configuration (the reason property on Configuration, Sources); the data type read by the sweep hourly, or at once while unchecked (0008zb); an asset register's fields by cma.set_connection_field in Studio (0008zj)

tables.name: connection_reason
tables.what: The options of a connection's reason property per record type (a deal's lost reason, a ticket's reason): value, label, order, whether a person marked it data quality, active or archived (0008zb)
tables.how: The sweep reads the mapped dropdown property's options from HubSpot hourly, or at once while its type is unchecked; an option gone is archived, never deleted; the data-quality flag is set on Configuration, Sources and kept by every refresh

tables.name: connection_record_kind
tables.what: The rules that give a connection's records a kind: the kind, a pipeline, a category value or both, active or archived (0008zb)
tables.how: Configuration, Sources, on the connection's page

tables.name: writeback_field
tables.what: Fields the CMA may write back to the CRM
tables.how: Configuration

tables.name: connection_inbox
tables.what: Inboxes of the CRM's conversations: counted, market, work type, channel
tables.how: The email poll's inbox catalog hourly (when the connection's email_poll is on); switches on Configuration

tables.name: connection_inbox_channel
tables.what: Channels of the CRM's conversations (email, chat, ...): the CMA channel, counted
tables.how: The email poll's channel catalog hourly (when the connection's email_poll is on); switches on Configuration

tables.name: connection_inbox_account
tables.what: Mailboxes: the channel accounts of the CRM's inboxes (a shared address connected to an inbox); the source's name, or its id when the name holds an address, a label a person sets, counted, market
tables.how: The email poll's catalog hourly with the inboxes (when the connection's email_poll is on); label, counted and market on Configuration, Sources

tables.name: connection_email_rule
tables.what: Email classification rules: words in a sender domain or subject, the category, in order
tables.how: Configuration (the functions of 0008m; the screen comes with B17c)

tables.name: workday
tables.what: One workday per person and date
tables.how: Clock in and out in the Workspace, immediately; hourly job closes forgotten days

tables.name: time_event
tables.what: Clock in, status changes, clock out, corrections
tables.how: Every click in the Workspace, immediately; corrections by supervisors

tables.how: Roster screen

tables.how: Publish on the Roster screen

tables.how: One-off

tables.how: One-off

tables.name: import_session

tables.how: One-off

tables.name: legacy_call_batch
tables.what: One imported file of a former telephony system's legacy call outcomes: the source system, the CRM connection it was matched against, the file's SHA-256 (one live batch per file), the cutover date, row counts per match method, times and the withdrawal; no personal data (0008zg)
tables.how: Legacy import (one-off job), on demand: the job ingest-import-legacy-calls started by hand on one export file in a private bucket; the same file again reuses its batch; an admin withdraws a batch once

tables.name: legacy_call_outcome
tables.what: Legacy call outcomes of a former telephony system, one row per imported row: the date, the tag meaning, the former system's tag text, the CRM contact matched (by id) or none, and the match method (email and phone, email, phone, customer id, none, conflict or forgotten); never an email, phone number, name or customer id (0008zg)
tables.how: Legacy import (one-off job), on demand: ingest-import-legacy-calls matches each row of the file to at most one HubSpot contact in memory and writes it; a rerun fills a contact only where none is set and never refills a forgotten row; with the job option --unmatched skip (Pulse4all's choice) only rows matched to exactly one contact are written, none and conflict rows are not stored; the CRM's privacy deletion of a contact sets forgotten

tables.how: People screen

tables.how: Messages screen, or a rule when a lead is assigned or a published review of a counted channel comes in at or below a review rule's highest rating (the reviews poll, 0008ze); Delete on Messages withdraws one (messages.withdraw)

tables.name: follow_up_snapshot
tables.what: Per tenant: when the follow-up figures were last computed and how long it took, the eight counts and the figures per person (ids and counts, no names)
tables.how: Replaced every minute per tenant by the refresh job cma-refresh-follow-up (cma.refresh_follow_up, since 0008s); computed once on demand when a tenant has none

tables.name: follow_up_item
tables.what: Every open lead, ticket and task of the latest refresh: kind, order, market, owner as a person, state, and the row's fields as JSON (ids, codes and times; never a task's text)
tables.how: Rewritten with the snapshot every minute per tenant from cma.open_leads_of, open_tickets_of and open_tasks_of (since 0008s); derived, no audit trigger

tables.name: ingest_event
tables.what: Every incoming event and its processing state
tables.how: Each webhook or sync event; sweep retries every minute

tables.name: sync_run
tables.what: Every job run with counts
tables.how: Each sweep, form poll, email poll, reviews poll (hourly, since 0008ze), reconcile and backfill; since 0008r the scheduler's forgotten-day close too, without a connection; since 0008s the follow-up refresh every minute per tenant, without a connection; since 0008zi each device snapshot load (job assets_import), run by a person, no schedule; since 0008zj the asset register poll (job assets_poll) every 5 minutes, each connection when due, and its full snapshot in the nightly reconcile

tables.name: sync_cursor
tables.what: Where each job resumes
tables.how: Each job run

tables.what: Actions out to the CRM
tables.how: Worker by hand; unused since 13 October

tables.how: Database trigger on every change

derived.name: speed_to_lead
derived.what: Per lead: first call, agent, time to first attempt in business hours, within target

derived.name: lead_to_order
derived.what: Per lead: the first order it led to and days to order

derived.name: intake_per_day_v
derived.what: Per day and market: forms, deals, tickets, calls, new customers, orders, renewals

derived.name: crm_record_detail
derived.what: Amount, currency, channel, category and the reason's option value of deals and tickets

derived.name: workday_summary
derived.what: Per workday: working, productive, paid and billable seconds

derived.name: time_interval
derived.what: Every status interval with its length

derived.name: roster_published_entry
derived.what: The published version of every roster entry

derived.name: open_lead
derived.what: Every open lead deal not called: owner, market, age in business days and its bucket, past the target, the last call (0008o)

derived.name: open_ticket
derived.what: Every open ticket of a counted pipeline against its SLA: business minutes open, the SLA in force, ok, at risk, breached or no business hours, minutes to breach (0008o)

derived.name: open_task
derived.what: Every open task: type, priority, status, owner, due time and whether it is overdue, due today or later, the deal or ticket by id (0008o)

derived.name: follow_up_summary
derived.what: Per tenant: counts of leads not called and past the target, tickets at risk, breached and without owner, tasks overdue, due today and with an owner nobody maps to (0008o)

derived.name: follow_up_by_owner
derived.what: Per person (by id) and one row for owners nobody maps to: open leads, past the target, open tickets, at risk or breached, tasks overdue and due today (0008o)

derived.name: connection_pipeline_sla
derived.what: Per pipeline: its own SLA in business minutes, or null for the tenant default (0008o)

derived.name: email_waiting
derived.what: Open conversations whose latest message is the customer's: inbox, mailbox, market, waiting since, business and elapsed time, the link to the conversation

derived.name: email_not_responding
derived.what: Open lead deals whose contact got an agent email at least email.no_response_days ago with no email, inbox message or phone conversation back since: deal, pipeline, market, owner, the last email

derived.name: first_orders
derived.what: Per won deal of an order pipeline: market, when, the linked shop order by id, kind (first, repeat, renewal, not first, no contact), currency and amount, the evidence found before it (lead deal, conversation, email, phone match, attempt, known contact), its level, call center or self-service, days from the first touch, the credited person by id (0008u)

derived.name: callbacks_kept
derived.what: Per callback task (a counted callback type) since the intake start: due date, ISO week, the owner's person by id, kept, not kept, pending, without a contact or a due time, the keeping call's time and its minutes from the due time (0008w)

derived.name: attempts_per_deal
derived.what: Per sales deal (a lead pipeline, never an order pipeline) since the intake start: market, pipeline, stage, the owner's person by id, created, closed, the contacts' first order after the creation (ordered_at) and why the window ended (closed, ordered or open), the outcome (won, lost, ordered, unknown, open), the attempts in the window (outbound Aircall calls on the deal or its contacts; every outbound HubSpot call when attempts.source is crm), those that were a conversation (from the linked Aircall call only: connected, at least calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds of talk and no tag meaning not reached or incorrect data) and the first that was, talk time in all and on conversations, the first and last attempt, the speed to lead in business seconds and called before the next noon, for open deals the business days since the last attempt with its bucket, the attempts without an outcome and the HubSpot calls logged without an Aircall call. From HubSpot deals, contacts and calls, Aircall calls with their link, and shop orders; computed on read, so as current as the mirror (0008y, for sales since 0008z, conversations since 0008zc)

derived.name: deal_funnel_rows
derived.what: Per sales deal (a lead pipeline, never an order pipeline) since the intake start and per stage with a stored time: the deal's ids, pipeline, current stage and its outcome, the outcome, the reason's option value, market, created and closed, and the stage with its entry and exit; a deal without any stage time as one row without a stage. From HubSpot deals and their stage history; computed on read, so as current as the mirror (0008zb)

derived.name: cancellation_rows
derived.what: Per record of the tenant's cancellation kind (reports.cancellation_kind, matched by its rules) since the intake start: the kind, ids, pipeline, stage, created, open or closed, closed, the reason's option value and the market (the record's, else its contact's country). Requests, never contracts; computed on read (0008zb)

derived.name: reviews_per_day
derived.what: Per tenant and business day: the counted reviews (published, of a counted review channel), the average rating, the distribution by whole star, the negative ones, the link levels (order, contact, none) and the previous day's count and average. From the review platform's reviews, by the day they were submitted in the tenant's zone; computed on read (0008ze)

derived.name: reviews_per_week
derived.what: The same per ISO week, with the previous week's count and average (0008ze)

derived.name: reviews_per_market
derived.what: Per market and ISO week: the counted reviews, average rating, star distribution, negative ones, link levels and the previous week's count and average; the market is the review channel's, unknown when it has none (0008ze)

derived.name: reviews_per_channel
derived.what: Per review channel and ISO week: its name, market, the counted reviews, average rating, star distribution, negative ones, link levels and the previous week's count and average (0008ze)

derived.name: review_market_state
derived.what: Per active market: whether it has a counted review channel and whether that channel holds published reviews (no channel, channel without reviews, has reviews), with the channels and the published reviews they hold (0008ze)

derived.name: maintenance_due
derived.what: Every due item of the tracked devices as of each tenant's date: component or end of life, due date with its basis (recorded, rule, unknown), action date and month, past due, the planned exchange it belongs to (0008zi)

derived.name: maintenance_per_month
derived.what: Per action month, market and model: due items, component items, devices at end of life, planned exchanges whose first action date falls in the month, past due (0008zi)
